title: add rag agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Ava Patel
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts, example playbooks demonstrating tool-calling, and the associated docs site updates. Motivation: make it easy for engineers to adopt RAG + agent patterns with Redwood by providing ready-to-run templates, concrete tool-calling examples (search, DB, calendar), and end-to-end quickstarts that map to the SDKs and redwood-examples. This PR includes: - RAG agent templates (Python + TS) with configuration and sample retriever setup - Tool-calling handlers and example tools (search, vector DB lookup, HTTP tool) - Quickstart docs pages and sidebar entries for mkdocs - Small CI smoke tests that run examples in a lightweight mode - Updated examples repository links and cross-references Checklist: - [x] Add example agent templates and configs - [x] Add quickstarts and docs site entries - [x] Add smoke CI tests for examples - [x] Update mkdocs navigation and include example screenshots - [x] Run CI and fix linting/comments Related: ENG-3289, PM-541, SUP-1123. Quickstart flow described in docs: clone examples, configure RAG retriever (local or hosted vector store), run the provided docker-compose for example services, and execute the agent with a sample prompt. See code snippets in examples and docs for how to wire the SDK call and tool registration.

chore: update links in redwood-examples and bump example version
